summary: Shows the combinations filter, which requires a set size, e.g. combinations(2) of [1..5].
questions: How do I get all pairs from a list in Ansible?
Does the combinations filter need a size?

answer_card.title: Combinations of a list
answer_card.answer_md:
Combinations always need a size:

```jinja
{{ [1,2,3,4,5] | ansible.builtin.combinations(2) | list }}
# => [(1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (1, 5), (2, 3), ...]
```
